fullDescription: The Nailed It Design System is a vibrant, high-precision aesthetic tailored for the beauty, wellness, and lifestyle sectors. It features a primary #E02EA3 pink palette on a crisp white background, utilizing the modern Plus Jakarta Sans for editorial-grade typography. The style is defined by soft shadows, generous spacing based on a 4px grid, and high-quality micro-interactions like subtle vertical translations on cards. Suitable for high-end SaaS dashboards, service-oriented landing pages, and professional portfolios that require a balance of polish and energy.

structured.summary: A modern, professional design system focused on clarity and vibrancy, using a signature pink brand color, clean white space, and a structured typography scale to create a luxury beauty/service brand feel.

style.description: Modern minimalism meets vibrant luxury. Features 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all UI text and 'JetBrains Mono' for code/technical data. The color palette centers on #E02EA3 with soft pastel accents and neutral grays. Design elements use large border radii (1rem to 2rem) and subtle drop shadows with color-matched glows.
style.prompt:
### Visual Style Guide
- **Brand Colors**: 
  - Primary: #E02EA3 (Vibrant Pink)
  - Dark: #C0268F
  - Light: #FCE7F3
  - Neutrals: #333333 (Text), #999999, #E8E8E8 (Borders), #F5F5F5 (Surface), #FFFFFF (Background)
  - Accents: #F0ABFC (Soft Purple), #FDA4AF (Coral)

- **Typography**: 
  - Font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif
  - H1: 48px / 3rem, weight: 800 (Extrabold), line-height: 1.2, tracking: -0.025em
  - H2: 36px / 2.25rem, weight: 700 (Bold), line-height: 1.2
  - Body: 16px / 1rem, weight: 400 (Regular), line-height: 1.6
  - Caption: 12px / 0.75rem, weight: 600 (Semibold), uppercase, tracking: 0.1em
  - Code: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace 

- **Effects & UI Logic**:
  - Corner Radius: `xl` (1rem/16px) for buttons/inputs, `3xl` (1.5rem/24px) for cards, `full` for badges.
  - Shadows: Buttons use `0 10px 15px -3px rgba(224, 46, 163, 0.2)`. Cards use `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`.
  - Interactions: All transitions use `duration-200 ease-in-out`. Hover states for cards involve a `translate-y-[-4px]` transform.

layout_and_structure.description: Structured modular vertical flow with a max-width container of 1280px. Sections are separated by large white space (128px) and introduced with a signature pink accent bar.

prompts.prompt: Sticky navigation bar, height: 72px. Background: white with a 1px #F1F5F9 bottom border. Left side: Logo (h-10) with stacked brand title and versioning text. Right side: Horizontal nav links (font-size: 14px, weight: 600) with 32px spacing. Primary CTA button as a rounded-full pill in brand pink.

Max-width 768px text container. Features a massive H1 (48px-60px) with keyword highlighting in brand pink. Followed by an H3-sized lead paragraph (20px) in #6B7280 gray with a line-height of 1.75. Vertical spacing between heading and text: 24px.
Consistent section intro pattern: A 48px wide, 4px tall horizontal bar in #E02EA3 placed to the left of an H2 heading. Margin bottom of 40px before the content grid starts.
3-column grid for components or 4-column grid for color swatches. Gap: 32px to 48px. Mobile fallback to 1 column.

Dark mode contrast section. Background: #0F172A. Container: 2rem rounded corners. Text color: #FDF2F8 (light pink tint). Uses JetBrains Mono for code snippets with border-slate-800 for internal dividers. Includes a background blur glow effect (#E02EA3 at 10% opacity).

special_ui_components.description: A white card with premium shadow and hover animation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background: #FFFFFF; Border: 1px solid #F3F4F6; Padding: 24px; Radius: 24px; Box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.02); Transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Inside: A top row with a pill badge (bg: #E02EA3 at 10% opacity, text: #E02EA3, uppercase, 10px font). Footer: Separated by a 1px gray-50 border, containing a price label in bold pink and a square gray-50 icon button.

Padding: 12px 24px; Background: #E02EA3; Text: #FFFFFF; Font-weight: 700; Radius: 12px; Shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(224, 46, 163, 0.2); Hover: background #C0268F and slight scale up (1.02x).
